_template: 21_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.json — provenance for every conclusion in the invention package
_purpose: Every conclusion in 22_FINAL_ADJUDICATION must reference one or more evidence_ids in this ledger. Each evidence_id traces to a primary source (with passage) or is explicitly labeled model-derived.

evidence.evidence_source: <where the evidence comes from: patent number, FDA database, ISO standard, benchmark source, physics model, etc.>
evidence.source_type: patent_primary_text | fda_database | iso_standards | industry_benchmarks | physics_simulation | patent_law_framework | model_derived
evidence.passage: <direct quote from primary source, with location (claim number, column, line, etc.)>
evidence.passage_hash: <sha256 of the passage string, for tamper-detection>
evidence.model_derived_note: <required if model_derived=true; what was derived and from what inputs>
evidence.artifact_pointer: <file this evidence is recorded in, e.g., TASK1_RETENTION_PASSAGE_AUDIT.json>

primary_source_count: <count of evidence entries where source_type=patent_primary_text or fda_database or iso_standards>

bidirectional_trace._rule: Every conclusion in 22_FINAL_ADJUDICATION must reference evidence_ids in this ledger. Every evidence_id must resolve to an artifact_pointer that exists in SHA256SUMS.

model_derived_labeling_check._rule: Every evidence entry with source_type=model_derived must have model_derived=true AND non-empty model_derived_note.

notes: <human-readable summary of evidence coverage; explicit acknowledgment of model-derived elements per CEO governance rule>
